payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Florence, Phyliss, Romona, Vicente

payload.content: Hi all — Florence here. My skill is documentation (0.72), so ISSUE-0001 tasks (documentation tag) are cheapest for me. My lowest-cost pick is ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 4.34, high priority). I can also take ISSUE-0001::docs or ::review (5.43 each). ISSUE-0002 tasks are very expensive for me (15–30), so I'd prefer to leave those to someone with api-development skill. Please share your intended picks so we avoid duplicates.

Proposed coordination: I'll claim ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 4.34). Romona/Phyliss/Vicente — if you also want a documentation task, please take ::docs, ::review, ::implement or ::test instead, and leave api-development (ISSUE-0002) to whoever has that skill. Reply with your pick so I can adjust if there's a conflict.
Finalizing: Florence will claim ISSUE-0001::triage in execution. Unless I hear a conflict, that's my pick. Good luck everyone.

Phyliss here. My skill is ui-ux-design (0.70), so ISSUE-0001 tasks are cheapest for me too. My costs: triage=4.44, review=5.55, docs=5.55, test=7.77, implement=11.09; ISSUE-0002 is very expensive (review=15, test=21, implement=30). Florence is taking ISSUE-0001::triage, so I'll avoid that. Proposed: I claim ISSUE-0001::review (cost 5.55). Romona/Vicente — please take other ISSUE-0001 tasks or the api-development ones (ISSUE-0002) if you have that skill. Reply if you want ::review and I'll switch to ::docs. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Finalizing: Phyliss will claim ISSUE-0001::review (cost 5.55, high priority) in execution. If anyone else needs ::review, say so and I'll switch to ::docs (also 5.55). Otherwise holding this pick. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Vicente here. Skill: ui-ux-design (0.84). My costs: triage=3.84, review=4.80, docs=4.80, test=6.73, implement=10.61; ISSUE-0002 is expensive (review=15, test=21, implement=30). Since Florence has ::triage and Phyliss has ::review, I'll take ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 4.80, high priority) to avoid duplicates. Romona — please take ::test or ::implement (ISSUE-0001) or an ISSUE-0002 task if you have api-development skill. Holding ::docs unless I hear a conflict.

Romona here. Skill: documentation (0.78). My costs: triage=4.07, review=5.09, docs=5.09, test=7.12, implement=10.18; ISSUE-0002 is expensive for me (review=15, test=21, implement=30). Florence has ::triage, Phyliss has ::review, Vicente has ::docs — so I'll take ISSUE-0001::test (cost 7.12, high priority). This gives us 4 distinct high-priority tasks done with no duplication. Vicente: I'd suggest you or another agent with api-development skill consider ISSUE-0002 only if feasible, but given costs it's likely better to leave ISSUE-0002. Holding ISSUE-0001::test unless I hear a conflict.

ISSUE-0002 tasks are prohibitively expensive for all of us (15–30), so we leave them unclaimed — that maximizes tasks_done with minimal total cost. I'll commit ISSUE-0001::triage in execution. No further changes needed. (phase=planning, iter=1)
